_comment: STATIC-DERIVED records: NOT captures. Each one is what ANTICATER.app's own packet
builder (x86_64 Mach-O, Qt 5.12.9) writes into its PHY2_KEY_Value record table, read from the
disassembly; HID_write @0x10003dea0 sends that record as-is after report id 03. Key 02 and
device layer 01 are fixed for every entry (the builders take both from the selected gesture).
Delay bytes are 00: on_CleanButton_clicked @0x100043850 zeroes bytes 5..61 before a mouse
action, and the delay page (onSpinBoxValueChanged @0x100044100) can rewrite them at save time.
Kept apart from vendor_capture.json on purpose: nothing here was seen on the wire, and the
two sources must never be mixed. `reproduce` names the antiknob action whose 0xFD record must
equal the frame; null means antiknob has no action for it (decode-only).
`led_records` are whole LED writes (not 0xFD slot records): `reproduce` is the `antiknob led <layer> <spec>` spec whose packet must equal `hex`.

led_records.source: static: Widget::HID_write @0x10003dea0 (LED branch: record `fe b0 <layer> <_RGB_LED_Md[layer]>` then 48 bytes of _KeyBoard_KeyLed @0x10022f6e0 + 48*layer, copied to record byte 4 onward; initialised data, identical for all three layers)
led_records.establishes: LED write: 48 colour bytes = 16 RGB triplets start at packet byte 5, straight after the mode byte (no separate base colour); the vendor sends them with every mode
